g. The JPS will prepare alpha list schedules (Schedule 1 and 2 etc.) and check if they are reconciled with the total tax remittances. The SPS then checks the correctness of the schedules.
h. The JPS and SPS will ensure the accuracy of the following items:
• That the BIR 1601-C is equals to YTD in the system and Alphalist Schedule
• That all employees have their tax withheld equals to tax due
• That all employees with tax adjustment (payable/refund) were given on the last payroll of the year or as advised by the client
• That there are no employees exceeding P 90,000 bonus threshold
• That in case there are employees exceeding P 90,000 bonus, excess amount will be reclass and properly be reported
• That all de minimis must not exceed the set amount per BIR ruling
• All employees on hold during the last payroll of the year must be forced annualized
• That all salaries of rehired employees were consolidated

c. The MIC will then review for unusual information.
d. The JPS will transmit the forms using the BIR 2316 transmittal letter (Standard letter 7).
e. The JPS will generate the soft copy of BIR forms 2316 for submission of the MIC to the client.

a. The JPS will collect the signed 2316 to the clients and save in the DVD-R or USB. Naming convention of file in the DVD-R will also be checked. The JPS will prepare the alphalist package based on the checklist of BIR requirements. The SPS will check the accuracy and completeness of the filing requirements. The MIC will then review the requirements.

b. The JPS will submit the forms to the RDO on or before February 28 and send the received copy to the client sealed in an envelope marked with “CONFIDENTIAL” and “ADDRESSEE ONLY” with properly filled out errand slip. The SPS will ensure the received copies are delivered and the soft copies are saved in Orion.
c. The MIC to ensure that the filing is completed and update the alphalist monitoring.
